'''{{PAGENAME}}s''' are one of five different types of basic seeds, to be utilized at the [[Kitchen Garden]]. They must be planted in an [[empty garden bed]] and may be harvested after a certain amount of time. In order to obtain {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}s, you will likely need to purchase them from [[Dig]], though there is a small chance in finding some within the [[Dungeon]].

Harvesting a mature crop will return some seeds, though without using a quality fertilizer, the chance of receiving enough seeds to replant the crop is very unlikely. See the relevant articles on each fertilizer - or the general article on [[farming]] - for more info.
